title: Skin tightening
caption: Skin tightening treatments work by triggering your body's own collagen production — not by adding anything from outside. Most devices use heat energy (radiofrequency, ultrasound, or laser) delivered below the skin's surface to create controlled injury that the tissue then repairs, gradually firming as it heals. Results build over weeks to months, not days. Knowing that changes how you evaluate any clinic's timeline claims. Not medical advice, just the honest basics. Learn more at cliniclick.ae
